data.name: Ahtesham
data.gender_notes: Ahtesham is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'htm', meaning 'to carry' or 'to raise'. In Islamic context, it signifies someone who is elevated or noble in character. The name Ahtesham carries the meaning “Elevated, noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ahtesham usually hope their child will grow to embody elevated, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires righteousness and nobility.
data.etymology: Ahtesham belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elevated, noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahtesham total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
